purpose: Can reward-only per-episode evidence arbitrage outperform fixed source identities when reliable sources change independently every episode?
metric: completed occluded-navigation tasks / 40 per seed; also cue accuracy
comparisons: source/context identity-only reward baseline with identical training episodes
constraints: No correct source, true beacon, actual goal position, simulator regime or reward hindsight enters selector action API
No paired training target cue; training feedback is terminal boolean only
Probe outcomes and each cue's forecasts are public *before* choice; the cue generator may use public beacon only to synthesize benchmark truth
Simple max-agreement heuristic and identity lookup are mandatory references
Development seeds are examined after freeze; reserved seeds only after implementation is frozen, no retuning on them
No test-namespace model updates, action authorization or default replacement
All seeds and regression failures retained
No D3 claim without beating strong simple alternative on new task families
